title: Vectorized pairwise distances
summary: Euclidean distance and cosine similarity matrices from one matrix product, with a clip at 0 and a zero-vector rule.

mutants.cosine_norm_axis0: Takes the norms of B over axis 0, so it divides by column norms and not row norms.
mutants.cosine_zero_nan: Divides by the norm product with no zero rule, so a zero vector gives NaN.
mutants.no_clip: Does not clip the squared distances at 0, so rounding gives a negative value and the square root gives NaN.
mutants.plus_cross_term: Adds 2ab to the squared norms and does not subtract it.
mutants.square_of_sum: Squares the sum of each row and not the sum of the squares.
